page_note: No cosmological substrate on this page. The first half (0-18) is the closing of a chapter on a catechumen: pastoral exhortation about loving fellow believers despite their sins, framed by apostolic dialogue and the catechumen's tearful confession. The second half (19-37) opens chapter 89 — the Nazoraean who questions the Teacher: pure apostolic dialogue frame combined with anti-Nazoraean polemic. Teaching purity is 0.000 as the score data correctly indicates. Strong editorial fatigue with apostolic_dialogue and manichaean_polemic surging in the second half — but on this page that is structural (a new chapter begins at seg 19), not editorial drift extending substrate teaching.
